How It
Works
The EF Hult Prize Challenge
The EF Hult Prize challenges students to launch for-profit startups that support at least one UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG). At the end of the competition, one team will win $1M USD in seed funding to bring their idea to life.
Getting Started
Whether you're building a business from scratch or growing an early-stage venture, you're welcome in our community. All you need to start, is a team and an idea.
Form a Team
Connect with 2-3 other eligible students and register your team.
Solve a Problem
Develop a for-profit, for-good business idea using design thinking.
Compete
Build your business plan, submit your application and start pitching!
Who is eligible to compete in EF Hult Prize?
We welcome teams of 2-4 students from almost every country in the world who are:
At least 18 years of age
Enrolled in any degree-granting program (including undergraduate and graduate programs) at the time of registration.
Pitching a for-profit business that directly supports at least one UN Sustainable Development Goal (SDG)
How to Register
Once you’ve formed a team, identified a problem and developed a solution, you’ll register online to compete in our qualifying rounds. If your institution hosts a local competition on campus, you’ll be connected with the organizers. If not, you’ll be directed to submit through our Open Application.
Register for EF Hult Prize
Competition Rounds
The EF Hult Prize competition runs September through September and consists of 5 successive rounds: Qualifiers, Nationals, Digital Incubator, Global Accelerator and Global Finals.
The Competition Journey
Evaluation Criteria
Our progressive scorecard rewards both early promise and sustained growth, focusing on:
Innovation and impact
Business model viability
Execution and traction
Team strength and leadership
Our evaluation process
The Million Dollar Deal
At the end of the competition, one of our top 8 finalists will secure $1M in seed investment to advance their business. The EF Hult Prize Foundation receives an equity stake in the winning startup (typically 10%), which we use to fund our non-profit operations. Be sure to read our terms and conditions carefully to ensure this is the right opportunity for you.
Terms and Conditions
Beyond the Competition
When you join the EF Hult Prize, you unlock more than a chance at $1M. Participants gain access to educational opportunities, perks and scholarship opportunities, mentorship, investment connections, and a lifelong global network of social entrepreneurs committed to building a better world.
Get Involved
Frequently Asked Questions

A 4-minute Pitch Video (Youtube Link)
A Pitch Deck (PDF)

Yes! All submissions must be in English, and all official competition phases will be held in English. You must attach an acceptable translated version if the original document is not in English.
Hult Prize welcomes existing social enterprises to compete. The competition will allow you to take your business to the next level. All stages of startups are welcome. Our programs would have a more significant impact on companies that are looking for pre-seed and seed investment rounds.
Campus Directors/Organizing Committee Members cannot compete in their own campus program. This is a strict policy to ensure impartiality and fairness. However, Campus Directors are encouraged to apply with their team via OpenApp. On the application, they must show that they were a Campus Director for the Hult Prize, and it will most likely be viewed favourably.
After you complete your team’s submissions, your application will go through two essential steps:
Compliance Review
: We will check if your team meets our eligibility criteria and confirm that your submissions are complete and meet minimum requirements and standards.
Evaluation
: Expert judges will review business proposals, score teams, and provide recommendations to Hult Prize Foundations.
Subscribe to our newsletter
Sign-up to receive news, updates and inspirational content from Hult Prize community.
